title: Nvidia CEO demonstrates Microduck robots as 20,000 units sell
excerpt: Nvidia's CEO was seen playing with voice-command Microduck robots that recently sold 20,000 units.
body_html: Nvidia's CEO recently spent time playing with small robotic toys known as Microduck robots. During the demonstration, the small robots responded to voice commands by stomping their feet, making tiny R2-D2 noises, sitting down, taking a nap, and performing summersaults. According to the report, 20,000 of these interactive robots have already been sold.
